intro: Sketch Artist with 6 years of experience, creating customized black-and-white pencil and colored portraits on order.
bio:
Hi, I'm Summan, a sketch artist with 6 years of experience in bringing faces and memories to life on paper.
I create customized black pencil and colored portraits made especially for you, whether it's a birthday gift, a keepsake, or a tribute to someone special. Every sketch is made with precision, dedication, and attention to detail, so each portrait feels personal and true to the original.
Message me to order yours today!
commissions: Commission a portrait of one person, a couple, or a group. The quote depends on the size, the number of people, and the detail in the drawing.
contactIntro: Tell me who you’d like drawn and what you have in mind. I’ll help you choose the size and composition for your portrait.

commissionSteps.name: Share a photograph
commissionSteps.details: Choose a clear, well-lit reference photo and tell me who you’d like drawn. You can share more than one photo if it helps show their features.

commissionSteps.name: Agree on the details
commissionSteps.details: Tell me the size and date you have in mind. We’ll confirm the composition, price, and timing before I begin.

commissionSteps.name: Receive your portrait
commissionSteps.details: We’ll agree on how you’ll receive the finished drawing when we confirm your commission.

commissionRates.name: Individual portrait
commissionRates.details: A drawing of one person, composed around their expression and likeness.

commissionRates.name: Two-person portrait
commissionRates.details: Two people in one composition, drawn from a shared photo or separate references.

commissionRates.name: Family or group portrait
commissionRates.details: A group drawing with pricing based on the number of people, size, and detail.

faqs.question: What kind of photo works best?
faqs.answer: A sharp, well-lit photo with a clear view of each face is a good starting point. Send an alternate photo if a feature is hard to see.

faqs.question: Can you draw people from separate photos?
faqs.answer: You can share a photo of each person. We’ll discuss how they can fit into one composition when we review the references.

faqs.question: How much does a portrait cost?
faqs.answer: The quote depends on the size, the number of people, and the level of detail. I’ll confirm the price with you before starting.

faqs.question: How long will my portrait take?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the drawing and current availability. If you have an occasion or a deadline, include the date in your first message.

faqs.question: How will I receive the portrait?
faqs.answer: We’ll agree on collection or delivery when we confirm the commission. Let me know where the portrait needs to go.
